==Description==
The '''Static Nametag''' is an exclusive nametag, meaning it is exclusive to developers. It has been manually given to some people, such as content creators and some administrators.

The '''Static Nametag''' is similar to the [[Default Nametag]], as it has white text and a black outline. However, behind the text there is black and white static, similar to the static on a TV screen. The player's name is also glitched out.
